Hello Everyone, I am new here!
￼￼ I have a loved one in Israel for a while and things between us have been getting serious💙 I’m a Turkish citizen living in Turkey, we have met before in another country. Now we made plans about meeting his family in Israel, planning our marriage etc. Here is the issue that we are having, due to embassies being closed in Turkey visa applications are really slow. What I did is mail Istanbul Israeli Embassy for a tourist/visit visa application which they replied the very next day. It was really fast. They mailed me saying “due to embassy is being closed in Turkey the applications are being taken in Sofia, so e-mail us your passport copy, the invitation letter which my boyfriend wrote with all details in Hebrew, your purpose of visit and how long. This might take a while.” I sent everything they asked for the day they emailed me. No response for a week then I had the itch and emailed them a follow up mail asking. Has it been processing or do they need any other paperwork from me. No response of course. It is going to be three weeks soon. We are really upset about this. What do you guys think? What can we do about this? Even a little information would be appreciated 💙
